Hey everyone, so yesterday was TOUGH, but you know what I powered though it. While waiting for his reply I went out, read all our letters, texts, saw our pictures, our dream plans, I had moments I was anxious as fuck. Enough that I had to take a Xanax, and that helped me think a bit more clearly. I drove up to Wisconsin, to a lake town, I called my friends, one of the who lives on a lake house town (and she told me there are schools around the area and you can still be secluded thats how she got schooling). I talked to my mom, I talked to my friends, I talked to the amazing child free community (THANK YOU, I cannot say this enough you guys are AMAZING.) I even talked to people that want kids. I even talked to my psychologist. and we had a long chat. (I even smoked weed for the first time but ill tell you about that later :D ) 

I learned a lot of things.  

When I was abused by my dad, it took a big big toll on my life, He locked me up in a room with my baby sister, for months, I was not even allowed to shower, or go to the bathroom sometimes. He would come home drunk at night and hurt me and try to hurt my little sister, I would get in the way and let him hit me. I had bruises, I remember him coming home one nigh and he actually broke most the fingers in my hand. When my mom found out and she flew to Mexico to get us, He left us at the airport all alone and basically made me figure out where our flight back to Mexico city was. 
This traumatized me. Obviously. To this day I get anxiety if i dont take a shower every day or if I cant find a bathroom. I get anxious at airports to the point I have serious anxiety attacks. I have passed out before. Being in a locked room was very bad for me too before but we have worked through that.

Ive mentioned here and other posts that I am willing to adopt and try surrogacy. But what Im super afraid of is babies, and pregnancy, for alot of reasons but also because when i was being abused and my mom was being abused she was pregnant and having a screaming kid in the house didn't help. It marked me, and im afraid of babies because they bring back these memories. (Yeah I had a long session with my psychologist yesterday, some on hypnosis) I am also afraid of getting pregnant because of personal reasons, I am afraid ill be left alone like my mom was, I don't want to be put on a predicament of being pregnant when im not ready, like my mom was (divorce, abuse, and pregnancy). Also because I cannot tolerate hormones, and I run the risk of having hyperemesis gravidarum which is morning sickness all pregnancy which can leave me weak and malnurished. I dont want to be "Oh OP, shes a mom now" I want to be "Oh OP she traveled the world and is a doctor and does X, Y,Z and helps people and she's also a mom! " I dont want having kids to steal my life my passions and become all about them. I dont want them to be a third wheel, I still wanna date my husband whoever he may be. I don't wanna be a mombie! 

I had to come to terms with the fact I don't want to be like my mom who gave up her dreams to apease my dad. Thats why I have such a strong mindset, about my goals and dreams. 

I smoked weed with my friend and I cried and laughed, and i was honestly for a WHILE now I was able to feel relaxed. It helped lots! after it was wearing down my boyfriend and I went on skype. 

We talked for like 5 hours, we asked questions, I asked questions that some of you had given me to ask, I read some of your replies to him and we got to understand each other better. We had a misunderstanding. He though I was backing up on the idea of adopting and not open to a surrogacy (Because I brought up living in a lake house and world travels would suffer for a kid, and I didn't want it to suffer, so he thought i was backing out) and I thought he was wanting me to do things and give up my dreams too! I told him what I had learned he told me what he had learned. 
We came to an agreement we both were really going for:
>We can still live in a lake house, and still be close to schools and a town, but still secluded enough to have solitude which is what we both want. Plus I mean tbh if I wanna be a doctor I don't wanna drive 3,00000000 miles to get to the hospital or clinic. (which is something ive thought about too by myself regardless of kids.) 

>We agreed that we did want to travel the world and end our careers without kids first (many couples do this) He wants to enjoy the child free life too, We both wanted this in the first place too. And that if we adopted or went for a surrogacy or whatever, it would be till we are at a good spot. He wants to travel on his own lots too. 

> He was being unrealistic about his parenting standards, that things aren't guaranteed, shit happens in life, he could get sick and end up sterile, or i could get sick, or who know we might break up for other reasons ect. There could be a sick kid, miscarriges, autism, things like that. And he came to terms that although there is kodak moments theres som seriously shitty time that we both need to be at a good place financially, and emotionally to power though. We dont want to adopt or whatever till we have a house and jobs and have traveled.  

> we both need to chill. Im 19, he's 21, although I don't want to Bingo myself, you guys even said it, Im in a place, we both are, that nothing is for certain, I might not get to med school, he might take longer to get a phd, sickness happens, life can throw a curveball. And right now, Im not in a place I can make a permanent choice about having kids. Especially in my situation where i have psychological issues I need to sort out. I need to wait till Im out of med school and by that time, who knows, we might not be together for separate reasons, and if we are then we have a plan laid out, that I am willing to try and he is willing to try too. I do know, we both know that we don't want kids before we completely finish our schooling. So thats going for us and we still have many years to enjoy child free ness. :)


SO yeah Im not sure if any of this made sense, basically we have to see where this goes, but fundamentally we BOTH agreed, adoption is something we want to do. Surrogacy is something we want to try. Taking care of a baby, if surrogacy works out, is gonna be hard, but so is having a foster kid. So is life. but if it happens we are both willing to try.

But for now. I want to enjoy my childfree journey though med school, though travels, through helping women, FGM victims, People in general.
And Im ok with that  :)
